t: A roomy Linux board with a PCIe slot, Gigabit Ethernet, and display ports.
steps: Buy the board from the Pine64 store or ameriDroid in the US.
Get a 12 V barrel power supply rated for 3 A or more.
Get a microSD card and a 3.3 V serial adapter that runs at 1.5 Mbaud.
Download the DietPi image from the Pine64 releases page. Pine64 suggests it over Armbian for full memory detection.
Flash the image with a free tool such as balenaEtcher.
Connect Ethernet, HDMI, and power, and watch it boot.
Log in over SSH and run the DietPi setup menu.
Try a first project such as a network ad blocker.
meta: Open Board. From $59.99. A few stores.
